categories.title: Item Box
categories.info: *Item boxes hold your items, and are all linked - anything you put in a box can be retrieved from any other box.*

categories.title: Tape Recorder
categories.info: *Used to save the game. On Madhouse difficulty, [Cassette Tapes](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-7-biohazard/maps/baker-ranch?search=category:12382) are required to save.*

categories.title: Antique Coin
categories.info: *Antique Coins are used to purchase the items found in bird cages. There are 18 to find on Easy / Normal difficulty, and 33 to find on Madhouse difficulty.*

categories.title: Backpack
categories.info: Backpacks add four slots to your inventory.

categories.title: File
categories.info: *Read all 32 files in one playthrough to unlock 'The Devil Is in the Details' achievement.*

categories.title: Mr. Everywhere
categories.info: *Destroy all 20 bobbleheads to unlock items that boost your speed and defence (as well as the 'Mr. Nowhere' achievement)*

categories.title: Treasure Map
categories.info: *Treasure maps show you the rough location of some loot. The loot will only spawn after picking up the map.*

categories.title: Video Tape
categories.info: Can be viewed with the help of a [Tape Player](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-7-biohazard/maps/baker-ranch?search=player). Watch all four videotapes in a single playthrough to unlock the 'Be Kind, Please Rewind' achievement.

categories.title: Burner Fuel
categories.info: Used by the [Burner](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-7-biohazard/maps/baker-ranch?locationIds=444874). Can be crafted with Solid Fuel and Chem Fluid.

categories.title: Cassette Tape
categories.info: *Exclusive to Madhouse / Joe Must Die difficulty. Used to save the game.*

categories.title: Corrosive
categories.info: *Corrosive is used to melt certain locks on the ship. Anything you unlock while viewing the [Old Videotape](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-7-biohazard/maps/baker-ranch?locationIds=445489) will remain open in the present day.*

categories.title: Grenade Rounds
categories.info:
Used by the [Grenade Launcher](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-7-biohazard/maps/baker-ranch?locationIds=444909), and can be crafted: 
- Flame Rounds ([Strong Chem Fluid](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-7-biohazard/maps/baker-ranch?search=category:12385) + [Solid Fuel](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-7-biohazard/maps/baker-ranch?search=category:12393))
- Neuro Rounds ([Strong Chem Fluid](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-7-biohazard/maps/baker-ranch?search=category:12385) + [Supplements](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-7-biohazard/maps/baker-ranch?search=category:12390))

categories.title: Handgun Ammo
categories.info:
Used by handguns (namely the [G17 Handgun](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-7-biohazard/maps/baker-ranch?locationIds=444712) and [M19 Handgun](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-7-biohazard/maps/baker-ranch?locationIds=444839).)

Can also be crafted:
- Handgun Ammo ([Gunpowder](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-7-biohazard/maps/baker-ranch?search=category:12387) + [Chem Fluid](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-7-biohazard/maps/baker-ranch?search=category:12384)
- Enhanced Handgun Ammo ([Gunpowder](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-7-biohazard/maps/baker-ranch?search=category:12387) + [Strong Chem Fluid](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-7-biohazard/maps/baker-ranch?search=category:12385))

categories.title: Lockpick
categories.info: *Used to unlock various drawers and toolboxes.*

categories.title: Machine Gun Ammo
categories.info: Used by the [P19 Machine Gun](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-7-biohazard/maps/baker-ranch?locationIds=447045)

categories.title: Mag Ammo
categories.info: Used by the [44 MAG](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-7-biohazard/maps/baker-ranch?locationIds=444848). **Cannot be crafted.**

categories.title: Random Pickup
categories.info: Random pickups have fixed locations. The item you'll get is determined by whatever the game thinks you need (e.g herbs if you're low on health.)

categories.title: Shotgun Shells
categories.info: Used by the [M37 Shotgun](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-7-biohazard/maps/baker-ranch?locationIds=444731) and [M21 Shotgun](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-7-biohazard/maps/baker-ranch?locationIds=444823). **Cannot be crafted.**

categories.title: Chem Fluid
categories.info:
Versatile crafting material. Can be used to make:
- First Aid Meds ([Chem Fluid](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-7-biohazard/maps/baker-ranch?search=category:12384) + [Herb](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-7-biohazard/maps/baker-ranch?search=category:12383))
- Handgun Bullets x10 ([Chem Fluid](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-7-biohazard/maps/baker-ranch?search=category:12384) + [Gunpowder](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-7-biohazard/maps/baker-ranch?search=category:12387))
- Burner Fuel x100 ([Chem Fluid](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-7-biohazard/maps/baker-ranch?search=category:12384) + [Solid Fuel](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-7-biohazard/maps/baker-ranch?search=category:12393))
    - First Aid Meds ([Chem Fluid](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-7-biohazard/maps/end-of-zoe?search=category:12384) + [Critter](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-7-biohazard/maps/end-of-zoe?search=category:12396)) (End of Zoe DLC)
    - Stake Bombs ([Chem Fluid](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-7-biohazard/maps/end-of-zoe?search=category:12384) + [Tree Branches](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-7-biohazard/maps/end-of-zoe?search=category:12395)) (End of Zoe DLC)

categories.title: Gunpowder
categories.info:
Used to craft ammunition.
- Handgun Bullets x10 ([Chem Fluid](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-7-biohazard/maps/baker-ranch?search=category:12384) + [Gunpowder](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-7-biohazard/maps/baker-ranch?search=category:12387))
- Enhanced Handgun Bullets x10 ([Strong Chem Fluid](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-7-biohazard/maps/baker-ranch?search=category:12385) + [Gunpowder](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-7-biohazard/maps/baker-ranch?search=category:12387))

categories.title: Herb
categories.info:
Used to craft healing items.
- First Aid Med ([Chem Fluid](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-7-biohazard/maps/baker-ranch?search=category:12384) + [Herb](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-7-biohazard/maps/baker-ranch?search=category:12383))
- Strong First Aid Med ([Strong Chem Fluid](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-7-biohazard/maps/baker-ranch?search=category:12385) + [Herb](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-7-biohazard/maps/baker-ranch?search=category:12383))

categories.title: Psychostimulant
categories.info: Psychostimulants make it easier to find nearby items by putting markers above them. Can be crafted with [Chem Fluid](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-7-biohazard/maps/baker-ranch?search=category:12384) and [Supplements](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-7-biohazard/maps/baker-ranch?search=category:12390).

categories.title: Repair Kit
categories.info: *Used to repair the [Broken Shotgun](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-7-biohazard/maps/baker-ranch?locationIds=444823) or [Broken Handgun](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-7-biohazard/maps/baker-ranch?locationIds=444839) to turn them into functional weapons.*

categories.title: Separating Agent
categories.info:
Separating Agent is used to turn items back into Chem Fluid. It can be combined with:
- First Aid Meds
- Strong First Aid Meds
- Psychostimulants
- Handgun Ammo (at least 10x)
- Enhanced Handgun Ammo (at least 10x)
- Flame Rounds
- Burner Fuel (at least 100x)

categories.title: Solid Fuel
categories.info:
Used to craft ammunition.
- Burner Fuel x100 ([Chem Fluid](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-7-biohazard/maps/baker-ranch?search=category:12384) + [Solid Fuel](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-7-biohazard/maps/baker-ranch?search=category:12393))
- Flame Rounds x2 ([Strong Chem Fluid](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-7-biohazard/maps/baker-ranch?search=category:12385) + [Solid Fuel](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-7-biohazard/maps/baker-ranch?search=category:12393))

categories.title: Stabilizer
categories.info: *Stabilizers permanently increase your reloading speed.*

categories.title: Steroids
categories.info: *Steroids permanently increase your maximum health.*

categories.title: Strong Chem Fluid
categories.info:
Powerful crafting material. Can be used to craft:
- Strong First Aid Meds ([Strong Chem Fluid](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-7-biohazard/maps/baker-ranch?search=category:12385) + [Herb](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-7-biohazard/maps/baker-ranch?search=category:12383))
- Enhanced Handgun Bullets x10 ([Strong Chem Fluid](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-7-biohazard/maps/baker-ranch?search=category:12385) + [Gunpowder](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-7-biohazard/maps/baker-ranch?search=category:12387))
- Flame Rounds x2 ([Strong Chem Fluid](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-7-biohazard/maps/baker-ranch?search=category:12385) + [Solid Fuel](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-7-biohazard/maps/baker-ranch?search=category:12393))

categories.title: Supplement
categories.info:
Used to craft some powerful items.
- Psychostimulants ([Chem Fluid](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-7-biohazard/maps/baker-ranch?search=category:12384) + [Supplements](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-7-biohazard/maps/baker-ranch?search=category:12390))
- Neuro Rounds ([Strong Chem Fluid](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-7-biohazard/maps/baker-ranch?search=category:12385) + [Supplements](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-7-biohazard/maps/baker-ranch?search=category:12390))

categories.title: Bomb
categories.info: *Shoot bombs from afar to avoid damage.*

categories.title: Crate
categories.info: *Crates can be smashed to reveal a random item. Look out for crates with less tape than usual - they have bombs inside.*

categories.title: Examinable
categories.info: *Examine this object for extra story, dialogue, or just good old creepy vibes.*

categories.title: Telephone
categories.info: Take the call if you hear them ringing - this will advance the story.

categories.info: *Used to view [Video Tapes](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-7-biohazard/maps/baker-ranch?search=category:12403).*
